How it works

How ChatGPT Ads work.

ChatGPT Ads bring your brand into AI-powered conversations, reaching people exactly when they’re asking about products, services or solutions like yours.

  • Contextual & conversational

    Ads are matched using Context Hints, where advertisers describe the conversations and situations where their product is relevant — not just exact-match keywords.

  • Location-aware

    Advertisers can target specific Cyprus cities, including Nicosia, Limassol, Larnaca and Paphos.

  • Measurable & optimizable

    Track impressions, clicks and performance, with a minimum daily budget of €15 for EUR accounts — accessible for a first real-world test.

FAQs

ChatGPT Ads
in Cyprus.

The questions we get asked before a first campaign goes live.

Get my launch plan ↓
Are ChatGPT Ads available in Cyprus?

Yes. Cyprus is currently listed by OpenAI as a market with self-service access to ChatGPT Ads Manager, so advertisers can create and manage campaigns directly through the platform.

What is the minimum budget for ChatGPT Ads in Cyprus?

The minimum daily campaign budget for EUR accounts is €15. The right test budget depends on your objective, audience size and how much data you need before judging performance.

Can you target specific cities in Cyprus with ChatGPT Ads?

Yes. City-level targeting is available, including Nicosia, Limassol, Larnaca and Paphos, though geographic controls are currently less advanced than Google Ads or Meta Ads.

What are Context Hints in ChatGPT Ads?

Context Hints let advertisers describe the conversations, needs or topics where their product or service is relevant. They guide ChatGPT’s matching systems but aren’t exact-match keywords.

What do I need to create a ChatGPT ad?

The core ad creative is a title, description, image and destination website — a simpler setup than most established ad platforms, though the messaging still needs to fit a conversational context.

Are ChatGPT Ads better than Google Ads or Meta Ads?

Not necessarily — they serve different purposes, and Google and Meta remain far more mature ecosystems. ChatGPT Ads’ advantage is conversational context and Context Hints. We treat them as an additional experimental channel, not a replacement for a profitable existing budget.
